_about: Stale terms for scripts/doc-lint.mjs (doc-guard; seeded from the 2026-10-25 docs audit). term = plain text, regex = a case-insensitive pattern. A line with a history word (old, older, was, replaced, lifted, history, ...) is allowed unless history is false. allowLine is checked on the line plus the next one. Known stale lines another PR fixes: docs/doc-lint.json known.

terms.replacement: the campaign is exactly 2; Sector Ops 1-4
say it is removed, or drop it
